create_VGGBlock: create a VGGBlock module with specified conv layers, kernel size, and pooling for feature extraction
run_VGGBlock_forward: run the VGGBlock forward pass on a BxCxTxfeat input tensor to extract features
infer_conv_output_dim: infer the output dimension of a conv operation given input dimensions and sample channels
review_VGGBlock_init: review the VGGBlock constructor to understand how conv layers, ReLU, and pooling are stacked
refactor_VGGBlock_layer_norm: refactor the VGGBlock to enable or disable layer normalization between convolution layers
